brief:
Rapper Macklemore was removed as a supporting act from Ed Sheeran's US tour following pro-Palestinian comments made during his performances, Middle East Eye reported. The decision drew backing from Tommy Robinson, while musicians including Paloma Faith and Ms Rachel expressed support for Macklemore's stance.

The controversy reflects broader tensions within the entertainment industry over statements regarding the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, with artists publicly divided on both the removal and the underlying political positions.

title: Macklemore dropped from Sheeran tour over pro-Palestinian remarks
